upstreams.name: taste-skill
upstreams.reviewNotes: ui-dev is a customised fork of the v2 skill: scope widened to every surface, brand rules beat aesthetic defaults, marketing caps demoted to prompts, quotes and facts preserved, pre-flight reported honestly. The three style skills feed references/styles.md and the redesign skill feeds references/redesign.md.

upstreams.name: emilkowalski-skills
upstreams.reviewNotes: Vendored as copies with four local changes: descriptions edited so no two trigger on the same phrase; em dashes replaced; pick-ui-library made model-invocable so animate's hand-off to it works; the opportunities skill's four-question gate lifted into improve-animations/AUDIT.md. Not vendored: emil-design-eng, find-animation-opportunities, animation-vocabulary, ask-sonner.

upstreams.name: impeccable
upstreams.reviewNotes: Text lifted, not files: the four modes and the craft floor into the body, the operate reference and the copy, empty-state, cognitive-load and triage passages into references/operate.md, the typography lines into references/read.md, the product and design file conventions into references/design-file.md. The detector binary is a pinned npm dependency (package.json), updated by npm, not by this review.

upstreams.name: stitch-skills
upstreams.reviewNotes: Four skills vendored as companions in skills/, with four local changes: names without the stitch:: prefix so ui-dev routes to them by folder name; em dashes replaced in their markdown; upload-to-stitch loads STITCH_API_KEY from the plugin's .env into the shell and never reads it into the conversation; and extract-design-md writes docs/DESIGN.md with the open DESIGN.md format's own headings, each with a plain line under it, in place of its six numbered headings, which disagreed with ui-dev and with its own example file, and it carries no trade word a person with no design training could not read (its pointers to the uninstalled design-md and manage-design-system skills are gone). Their own confirmation checkpoints and .stitch/ paths are overridden by ui-dev's SKILL.md. Not vendored: generate-design, manage-design-system, design-md, enhance-prompt (hex in every prompt), stitch-loop and site-md (no human gates), code-to-design, taste-design, react-native, react-vite-dashboard, remotion, shadcn-ui. Text lifted into references/stitch.md: the generation rule (a design system present means no colour, font or theme in a generation prompt), the edit-prompt shape, the variant options, the id-shape table, the signed-URL and width-suffix rules, and the placeholder-link trap.
